text: 2026-08-03 evidence: added an independent R fmridesign receipt for structural 2x2 S07 (design.structural-2x2.v1), generated/finalized and checked by the manifest validator. RParityCorpusSuite now builds the public S07 event model and compares the semantic design against that receipt; the focused suite passes 9/9 on JVM and 9/9 on JS. Strengthened S16 with a test-only independent reduced-design normal-equation oracle; production OLS is compared on fitted values, residuals, projection action, reduced rank, and an estimable sum function, while duplicate components are rejected structurally. Focused S07/S10/S16 passes 3/3 on JVM and 3/3 on JS. The full first-level gate passes: scenario-testkit 3/3 both platforms; HRF 210/210 both; HRF laws 77/77 both; design 163/163 both; model 19/19 both; fit 168/168 JVM and 160/160 JS. Remaining criteria are broader scenario coverage, explicit alias diagnostics, and policy decisions; keep this bead open.
